thread:
Leah Ramos: Heads up — AcmeCloud PO is blocked in the portal. Procurement says EIN + exact legal entity name must match our invoice header before they’ll accept the PO. Legal also pushed a redline on the MSA yesterday. Can someone help triage?
Samir Patel: which PO number? I can pull the mismatch details.
Leah Ramos: PO 4502378 — ops bot flagged it: "vendor name mismatch: invoice uses "Redwood Inference, Inc." but PO lists "Redwood Labs LLC""
Marketplace Ops Bot: Automatic alert: PO 4502378 flagged — missing EIN and vendor alias mismatch. Status: HOLD. Link: https://portal.marketplace/acme/po/4502378
Miguel Torres: Ah ok. We already have an internal alias for Redwood Labs LLC but looks like Acme requires the tax/EIN on the PO payload. Their portal validation fails without it.
Jordan Kim: Two quick options: 1) provide a corrected PO payload with EIN + exact legal name; 2) vendor alias mapping push from Acme side (they sometimes accept a vendor alias table). Which is faster?
Leah Ramos: Acme procurement team said they can't accept just an alias; they need EIN on the PO. Asking finance to produce a corrected PO will take 2 business days unless we can supply a signed LOA.
Samir Patel: Finance can sign an LOA (letter of authorization) confirming the billing entity mapping. If Acme will accept LOA we can get it same-day. I'll ping finance now.
Miguel Torres: Also FYI, Legal redlined section 6.2 (payment terms) in the MSA. That needs a separate thread but it blocks countersignature. For the PO I think LOA + temporary acceptance can unblock provisioning.
Jordan Kim: If we send this template they asked for it. Paste below for LOA body they expect:
```
To: Acme Procurement
From: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Re: Authorization of billing entity
We confirm that Redwood Labs LLC (EIN: 12-3456789) is an authorized billing alias for Redwood Inference, Inc.
Signed: [Finance Head]
```
Leah Ramos: Perfect — Samir can you get that signed and send to procurement? I'll note Legal's MSA redline for parallel work.
Samir Patel: On it. Looping in finance: @Miguel can you confirm EIN and legal name to put on LOA?
Miguel Torres: Confirmed: EIN 12-3456789, legal name on tax docs is Redwood Inference, Inc. Alias Redwood Labs LLC is on file for marketplace.
Samir Patel: Sent to finance for signature. I told Acme procurement we can provide LOA in 4–6 hours.
Leah Ramos: Great. Follow-ups: Miguel — can you add the alias mapping record to our vendor registry once LOA is issued? Jordan — help track MSA redline thread so procurement knows we’re working both in parallel.
Jordan Kim: Will do. I'll create a separate channel thread for the MSA redline with Legal and Prod.
Samir Patel: Finance signed and sent LOA to Acme procurement. They acknowledged receipt and said they'll retry PO acceptance later today.
Marketplace Ops Bot: Update: PO 4502378 status changed to PENDING_ACCEPTANCE after new LOA uploaded.
Leah Ramos: Thanks team. Keeping this open until PO clears and we get signed MSA, but PO unblock looks good for now. :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: Noted — I'll push the alias mapping after reconciliation.
Samir Patel: If anything stalls, escalate to Acme CX lead (sarah.acme@acmecloud.com) — I added her on the thread.
Leah Ramos: Closing loop in this thread once we have acceptance + invoice header matched. Thanks everyone.
